'''Edeyn ti Gemallen Arrel''' is a [[Malkier]]i noblewoman, who lived in [[Fal Moran]] in [[Shienar]] and [[Chachin]] in [[Kandor]]

== Appearance ==
She has long dark hair to her waist with touches of white at her temples and large dark eyes.

== History ==
She was ''[[carneira]]'' or first lover to [[Lan Mandragoran]]. [[Malkier]] custom now ties Lan to her. After the first night of being lovers, she cuts Lan's hair to his shoulders and keeps a lock of it now, called a ''[[daori]]''.

== Activities ==
Years later she raises the [[Golden Crane]] for Lan. She meets Lan in the Throne Room of [[Kandor]] in [[Chachin]] and kneels before him, pledging her fealty to him. She plans for Lan to marry her daughter [[Iselle Arrel]] so Iselle can become Queen of [[Malkier]]. After Iselle is killed by [[Merean Redhill]], she loses her passion for life.
